card.title: GRENADIER GUARDS
card.flavorText: The Grenadier Guards is an infantry regiment of the British army and can be traced back to year 1656. At the start of WWII they were part of the British Expeditionary Force, but after the defeat in the Battle of Dunkirk they took on defensive duties in the UK. In 1944 the 1st, 2nd and 4th battalions were sent to serve in the North West Europe Campaign while the 3rd, 5th and 6th Battalions were sent to serve in the North African Campaign, the Italian Campaign and the final stages of the Tunisia Campaign. The Battalions of the Grenadier Guards saw action in most major military operations and battles from 1944 to 1945.
